title.zh: Drift exploiter sends $109M in Ether to Tornado Cash in 2 days
title.en: Drift exploiter sends $109M in Ether to Tornado Cash in 2 days

current_state.zh: Wallets linked to the $295 million Drift exploit moved another $46 million in Ether to Tornado Cash on Wednesday, bringing the two-day total to $109 million while roughly $138 million in Ether remains in exploiter-linked wallets.
current_state.en: Wallets linked to the $295 million Drift exploit moved another $46 million in Ether to Tornado Cash on Wednesday, bringing the two-day total to $109 million while roughly $138 million in Ether remains in exploiter-linked wallets.
